label: P6 - Light vs Dark
author: Zetherea Maxwell edited by Battle Litany

steps.label: Start/notes
steps.note:
Tanks get aggro on their add (group 1 = nidhogg, group 2 = hraesvelgr)
Split damage to keep their health within 3% (group 1 hits nid, group 2 hits hraes).

In pf, can preassign spots using the marker setup like the picture.

steps.label: Tether Positions
steps.note:
Stretch tethers, generally group 1 plant while group 2 adjusts so fire/ice is on each spot, but this can be preassigned. In pf, use a triangle of markers, with people inside the marker anchoring and outside flexing.

2 tiles from the higlighted white squares help for spots. For front spot, stand in the middle of the 1 marker.

steps.label: Tether Proteans
steps.note: This shows proteans resolving for tethers. Fire and Ice will hit each other once so they gain and then lose their respective debuffs.

steps.label: Tanks Visual
steps.note: In summary, both tanks pop cds always and stand NW/NE. If both are glowing, stack together.

steps.label: Hraesvelgr TB
steps.note:
Nidhogg's mouth is glowing.

Hraesvelgr's mouth is not glowing.

steps.label: Double TB
steps.note: Both are glowing, stack together on north side.

steps.label: Caster LB3/Health Check
steps.note:
Regulate damage so both bosses are even.

Mortal vow is applied to a random dps, so players should spread here. Anyone accidentally hit will get 50% max hp down.

steps.label: Akh Afah
steps.note:
Group 1 north, group 2 south.
Rep + soil/kerachole + shield for mit.
Hit nid if purple tether or hraes if white tether to equalize them within 3%.

steps.label: First Dive/TB
steps.note:
Nidhogg will dive and cut off either the west or east side of the arena
Hrae will do a hallowed wing to cut off north or south side of the arena
Only a single square will be available to use
Party should always be near the middle of the arena for this mechanic.

steps.label: Tanks Close Example
steps.note:
If hraes head is down then the two closest targets from hrae will get hit by a tankbuster.

make sure the wall tank is still inside the hitbox without clipping the other tank, and the party is outside the hitbox.

steps.label: Tanks Far
steps.note: If Hraes head is up then the two furthest targets from hrae will get hit by a tankbuster

steps.label: Mortal Vow Pass #1
steps.note:
Pass in middle.
DTTMR
DPS -> Tank -> Tank -> melee (generally g1 melee unless they got vow first but this should be discussed prepull) -> caster

steps.label: Wroth Flames
steps.note:
4 dark debuffs = spread
2 white debuffs = stack
no debuff = partner for stack.
Hraes becomes untargetable and dives 1/3 of the arena N -> S

steps.label: Orbs 1st Spawn
steps.note: Always go to nidhogg unless hraes dives through nidhogg. In that pattern, go to third orb set across from nidhogg (NE or SE).

steps.label: Orbs 2nd Spawn
steps.note:
In this example the party will be dodging to NW to start this mechanic.
If Hraes dives through Nid, party starts NE.

steps.label: Akh Morn 1/Dive
steps.note:
The movement for the party is a J pattern.
Start inline with the edge of the intercard marker. HEAVILY mit this damage, it hurts.

steps.label: Akh Morn 2/1st Orb
steps.note:
2nd akh morn hits, first orb resolves shortly after.
Go barely outside the first puddle here.

steps.label: Akh Morn 3/2nd Orb
steps.note: Akh Morn 3 resolve and 2nd orb explodes very shortly afterwards. Should be fine to hold W here after 2nd akh morn hit, but dodge outside of each puddle.

steps.label: Akh Morn 4/Orb 3
steps.note:
Akh Morn 4 will resolve.

Orb 3 will explode shortly after.

Hraesvelgr will reappear.

Nidhogg will start casting Hot Tail/Hot Wing. Hot Tail = go sides, Hot Wing = stay middle.

steps.label: Nidhogg Cast/Orb 3
steps.note:
Orbs 3 will be resolving here.

Players must resolve their debuffs at this time. 
Stack and no debuff players prioritize east (near Hraesvelgr).
Spread players prioritize west, towards Nidhogg.

steps.label: Hot Wing Example
steps.note:
Players line up as the following. Following general priority of west to east - Melee -> Ranged -> Healer -> Tank. Otherwise use your eyeballs and don't overlap.
I highly recommend marking the stack/no debuff players so they know who to stand with. 1 = close to hraes, 2 = closer to middle.

Remember to top the party.

steps.label: Hot Tail Example
steps.note: Melee -> Ranged -> Healer -> Tank

steps.label: Mortal Vow Pass #2
steps.note: Pass offset from middle, between hot tail/hot wing aoes to avoid clipping unsuspecting players.

steps.label: Akh Afah #2
steps.note:
Same as the first. Bosses must be within 3% of each other again here or else you will wipe.
Most likely hit hraes here.

steps.label: Hallowed + Hot Wing
steps.note:
Hallowed Wing + busters, but now hot tail/hot wing
Tail = go sides, wing = stay middle.

Tanks communicate before pull to decide who goes middle! Typically DRK and GNB want mid for cleave but comfort always prio.

steps.label: Hallowed + Hot Tail
steps.note:
If hraesvelgr's head is up instead, then tanks far.
Hot tail = go sides.

Vow tank takes middle

steps.label: Mortal Vow #3
steps.note:
Third pass, pass in middle.
Generally G1 melee priority but this should be discussed first. In this example, ninja can take pass since drg wants to cleave/dot quickly after touchdown.

steps.label: Static WB2 - APD
steps.note:
most common pf strat for APD.

static spots based on the image to the right.
Make sure D1 and D2 are precise so they don't  hit the tanks/die to damage!

The top right image provided by Rai shows a more detailed spot for tanks to stand. Anywhere in the green triangle formed by the yellow donut + marker intersection is safe. 

If the melee get short tethers, they will take around ~50k damage so be ready to mit/shield.

steps.label: 5N 1s WB2
steps.note:
Spread tethers.
5 tethers north, regen healer anchors south, shield healer anchors north. Simply stretch tether across in these spots.

NOTE: Use the brick line for in between spots.
Other 4 spots are on the markers.

steps.label: 5N 1s WB2 - 2
steps.note:
Tanks stack middle if double TB, else SW/SE.
Both should pop mit.

NOTE: Tanks should stand slightly north of intercard markers to avoid hitting the south anchor.

steps.label: Adjust
steps.note: if both healers get same tether, healer cheats one over to stretch tether and swaps with the DPS.

steps.label: Debuffs for cleanse
steps.note: Look north to prepare for dives. Ice debuff = go to nidhogg. Fire debuff = go to hraesvelgr and do NOT move.

steps.label: Dives - IMPORTANT NOTE
steps.note: Both tanks will stand in front of their respective bosses. These are wild charges so tanks make sure to be the closest players and position at the wall.

steps.label: Nidhogg Slams Down
steps.note: Nidhogg will land performing a slam. This falls off with distance so do not leave the north wall

steps.label: Mortal Vow #4/Enrage
steps.note:
There will be one more mortal vow swap. Caster swaps with a designated melee here.
Heal through tank dots.
